$comment: NeuroView rulebook (policy neuroview-v1). Every term is the measurement rule the pipeline applies to the ISBI 2015 masks (pipeline/src/offhand_pipeline/isbi2015.py, track_lesions and TrackParams); none is a clinical definition. Test sentences are about case isbi2015-training01, whose findings are measured from the dataset. rulebook-source.md is the same content as a source document for the Bedrock Automated Reasoning policy.

terms.definition: A connected group of voxels (26-connectivity) marked in a lesion mask at one visit.
The voxels that both rater 1 and rater 2 of the ISBI 2015 dataset marked as lesion at that visit.
A lesion at a visit none of whose voxels was marked as lesion at the visit before.
A lesion at a visit whose volume is at least 1.5 times, and at least 20 mm³ more than, the total volume of the lesions it overlaps at the visit before.
Only lesions of at least 10 voxels at the later visit are reported as new or enlarged.
Cubic millimetres: the number of lesion voxels times the volume of one voxel.
One of the dataset's scan time points for the subject, numbered in order from 1.

testSentences.text: The consensus of both rater masks shows a lesion of 45 mm³ at visit 2, not present at visit 1.
The lesion of 269 mm³ at visit 3 is up from 156 mm³ at visit 2.
A lesion that grew from 32 mm³ at visit 2 to 73 mm³ at visit 3 is an enlarged lesion.
A new lesion has no voxels that were marked as lesion at the visit before.
The lesion of 18 mm³ at visit 4 was not present at visit 3.
The lesion of 45 mm³ at visit 2 was already present at visit 1.
A lesion that grew from 156 mm³ to 170 mm³ is an enlarged lesion.
A lesion of 5 voxels at the later visit is reported as a new lesion.
The lesion of 269 mm³ at visit 3 is down from 156 mm³ at visit 2.
A new lesion overlaps a lesion that was marked at the visit before.
